name: poly_cyclotomic_reverse_eq_self
statement: (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n) : (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).reverse = Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (hn : 2 ≤ n), (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).reverse = Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ
informal: Cyclotomic polynomials Φ_n (n ≥ 2) are palindromic — strong induction: X^n - 1 = ∏_{d ∣ n} Φ_d, reverse is multiplicative, reverse(X^n - 1) = -(X^n - 1), reverse(Φ_1) = -Φ_1, and cancel the product over proper divisors d ≥ 2 by the induction hypothesis.
type: ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 ≤ n → (Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ).reverse = Polynomial.cyclotomic n ℤ
